Overview

Safi is a city in Marrakech-Safi with a population of 308,000. A coastal city known for its pottery industry, sardine fishing port, and historic Portuguese fortress. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
